chunks.heading: What is the purpose of Form PENS.T/2?
chunks.text: Pension transfer agreements accommodate the transfer of staff between employers other than UNJSPF member organizations by securing continuity of pension rights. UNJSPF has entered into transfer agreements with several international organizations and Governments (listed at www.unjspf.org/for-clients/transfer-agreements). Form PENS.T/2 submits an expression of interest to transfer accrued pension rights from UNJSPF under the relevant transfer agreement, under Article 13 of the UNJSPF Regulations.

chunks.heading: What is the deadline to elect a transfer-out, and what happens if I miss it?
chunks.text: An election to transfer accrued pension rights must be submitted within the deadline set in the relevant transfer agreement between UNJSPF and the new employing organization, and other eligibility conditions in that agreement must also be met. Since terms differ between agreements, it is strongly recommended to read the specific agreement. Failure to observe any deadline results in permanent forfeiture of the right to transfer.

chunks.heading: When is it NOT possible to transfer accrued pension rights?
chunks.text: It is not possible to transfer accrued pension rights while on secondment, special leave without pay, or loan from a UNJSPF member organization — you must separate from service before applying. At the end of a period of special leave without pay, the transfer is governed by the relevant transfer agreement and may be initiated only after the SLWOP and employment with the member organization are terminated. Transfer is also not possible if you have already withdrawn your benefits from UNJSPF, and only permitted where a valid transfer agreement is in effect.

chunks.heading: What is the process after I submit Form PENS.T/2?
chunks.text: You should inform UNJSPF in writing, as soon as possible and within the deadline in the relevant transfer agreement, by completing and submitting Form PENS.T/2, and should also promptly inform your new employing organization in writing per its own procedure. Completing the form does not commit you to transfer; UNJSPF verifies eligibility and provides an estimate of the transfer value. You must then respond within the deadline by completing a notice of final consent to transfer form, provided with the estimate.

chunks.heading: Is the decision to transfer reversible once final consent is given?
chunks.text: No. Once your notice of final consent to transfer is received, the decision is final and irrevocable, and you will no longer be entitled to any benefit under the UNJSPF Regulations.

chunks.heading: What information is needed for Section 1 (Participant Information)?
chunks.text: Provide your UID, full name, date of birth, current employing organization index number, and former employing organization information. If you do not know your UID, email requestUIDonly@unjspf.org from your work email, including your full name, last employing organization before separation, last duty station, and six-digit pension number. The pension number field is optional. Include your index number at your new employing organization to help identify you.

chunks.heading: What information is needed for Section 2 (New Employing Organization for the Transfer-Out)?
chunks.text: Provide the name of the new employing organization and date of entry, plus the full name, functional title and contact details of the point of contact at the new employing organization for the transfer-out.

chunks.heading: How do I submit Form PENS.T/2?
chunks.text: The dated and hand-signed form must be returned to UNJSPF, either via the 'MSS Document Upload' tab of a member self-service (MSS) account (scan and upload as JPG, JPEG or PDF), or by mail to UNJSPF's New York or Geneva offices.
